title: Migration entry test coverage
text: One shared table-driven harness discovers every packaged entry, checks destructive serving floors, applies twice on empty booted and seeded current schemas, and re-proves standing invariants with the production retirement rules. Dedicated tests retain reachable data-change and refusal assertions. Retiring historical coverage requires accounting for known hosted, local and self-hosted installs. A baseline squash deletes dedicated tests with their entries; a source check refuses references to absent entry modules or loader selectors. Migration-area impact selection includes both shared checks whenever an entry changes.
